decision: PASS for bounded final source-backed compound proposals
corrections_required_by_review: The60- and79-piece curved arc-only prototypes retained a whole-profile fascia hull. Deep tests to actual shelf rear depth found genuine9–23mm storage-depth losses despite broad central opening rays passing. They were rejected.

Five source-derived fascia height bands retain the real concave backing profile. Exact polygon subtraction handles source cap triangles spanning the convex bands without treating finite vertex probes as complete coverage.

Terminal toe/full-height hulls initially filled a real end/plinth recess. Height splits remove that invisible obstruction; additional source-fitted guest-profile splits reduce terminal surface overreach to≤3.19mm at sampled points.
The upper ivory rail uses a tighter arc parameter to preserve the actual deep upper-shelf endpoint. Final source/export geometry is unchanged.
residual_approximation: The largest independent sampled outside-solid error is9.649mm at the small shelf/front-lip convexification. This affects the region immediately above the shelf near its rolled lip; specified usable service height intervals and deep rear paths remain clear.
Fascia measured error is≤7.814mm curved and≤3.765mm straight; combined radial/profile approximation is not universally5mm accurate.
Terminal measured error is≤3.190mm after source-fitted splits. Floor support, seam endpoints, top support and accessible toe recess witnesses remain valid.

Drawer front bevel envelope retains about5.774mm sampled error; moving pan/walls/front remain separate from static supports. Decorative ribs/reveal/grip remain omitted as in the original numerical proposal.
evidence_limits: Independent surface maxima are finite-sample results, not global Hausdorff guarantees. Author report additionally records complete face-net covering-radius bounds.
All5,946 represented source surface triangles are continuously covered by matching functional-group hull unions; decoration omissions are explicit.

The19,879 source/compound paths, continuum corridor rectangles, prescribed drawer sweep and negative controls establish only their geometric scopes. No engine solver/contact response/controller/actor certification follows.
